name: How do I know if my log home needs refinishing?

mainEntity.name: How do I know if my log home needs refinishing?

acceptedAnswer.text: Signs that your log home may need refinishing include faded or discolored logs, peeling or cracking stain, evidence of mildew or mold growth, dry or brittle wood, and water penetration when it rains. If the logs appear dull, unprotected, or show signs of deterioration, it's a good indication that a refinishing project is necessary to prevent further damage and maintain the beauty and longevity of your home.
acceptedAnswer.description: Look for faded, peeling, or cracking stain, mold, dry wood, or water penetration to determine if your log home needs refinishing.
